grid_rule: official full-upstream intersection integer-truncated area weights; frozen before scores
tile_rule: 1degree groups; split rectangle >60cells if occupancy<0.5; bbox margin .001degree
driver: ARCO hourly deaccumulated tp; never difference; P timestamp -1h; hourly T round1/P round2; 24hour daily Psum round2/Tmean round1; month daycomplete Psum/Tmean; original2019end padding only overlap; actual2021-01-01boundary for2020
Q_source: previously obtained eHYD file5 daily-mean m3/s; no fill
prior_2020_Q_exposure: P6B ehyd parser read full downloaded archive into memory; no prior24station2020 model scores located. Not wholly blind test. This run segregates inference and scoring.
QC: MAIN_DESCRIPTIVE complete366 finite nonnegative daily values; STRICT_SENSITIVITY additionally exclude every OWF-Q footnote applicable to month (including background regulation). Neither means daily QC certification.
day_boundary: provider midnight intervals; timezone UTC equivalence unverified. Primary provider calendar, no score-selected shift. Fixed +/-1calendar-day sensitivity descriptive only, not a timezone conversion.
statistics: stationequal skills mean/median, separate macro water systems, no station independence or significance claim
